task_description: Build a complete SynthID watermark detection and removal tool with: core Python library wrapping reverse-SynthID logic, Typer CLI with detect/remove commands, FastAPI async backend, and React+Vite frontend with drag-and-drop UI. Supports fast mode (V3 spectral subtraction) and full mode (V4 7-stage pipeline).

verification.summary: All 46 pytest tests pass (19 backend + 10 CLI + 17 core). Frontend builds with 0 TypeScript errors. Package installs cleanly. CLI works. FastAPI app loads. Two rounds of semantic review completed with all issues addressed.
